sentences.text:
(Ia No.133607/2023-EXEMPTION From Filing C/C Of The Impugned
 Judgment and Ia No.133609/2023-EXEMPTION From Surrendering Within
 Time)
This petition was called on for hearing today.

Coram :
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice K.V. Viswanathan
 [In Chamber]
For Petitioner(s) Mr. Anish R. Shah, AOR  Mr. Sidhharth S. Chapalgaonkar, Adv.

For Respondent(s)
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R
The applicant seeks exemption from surrendering.

The applicant stands convicted for the offence punishable under Section 120-B read with 420 Indian Penal Code and under Section 13(2) read with 13(1)(d) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 and sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of one year with the fine of Rs. 1,000/- The applicant has already undergone two months in custody.

In view of the above and Considering the averments in the application for exemption from surrendering, the applicant is exempted from surrendering, subject to furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 5,000/- along with two sureties for the like sum each to the satisfaction of XI Additional City Civil and Sessions Judge, (CBI Cases relating to Banks and Financial Institutions, Chennai  1).
Necessary proof of the same be filed within two weeks.

(MAMTA) (AMITA PANDEY)
 SENIOR PERSONAL ASSISTANT COURT MASTER (NH)
